properties.name: FILL: network name (testnet: DEMOS)
properties.sudoPubkey: FILL: lowercase 0x + 64 hex key allowed to sign award transactions, or delete this field to accept none

gasFeeSeparation.treasuryAddress: FILL: lowercase 0x + 64 hex mainnet treasury account

notaryKeys.hex: FILL: primary notary public key from the notary key ceremony, 33-byte compressed secp256k1, lowercase 02 or 03 + 64 hex
FILL: cold standby notary public key from the notary key ceremony, 33-byte compressed secp256k1, lowercase 02 or 03 + 64 hex

tlsnVerified.verifierWasmSha256: FILL: sha256 of native/tlsn-verify/dist/demos_tlsn_verify.wasm in the launch release, 64 lowercase hex

snapshot.manifestSha256: FILL: sha256 of the launch snapshot's manifest.json bytes (keep this field: the launch checks require the snapshot)

balances: FILL: [["0x<64 hex address>", "<amount>"], ...] the agreed allocations, whole starting balances in OS (1 DEM = 10^9 OS; see genesis.md)
timestamp: FILL: launch time in seconds, a positive integer string (testnet: "1692734616")
validators: FILL: launch validators, one object each: {"address", "status": "2", "connection_url", "staked_amount", "first_seen": 0, "valid_at": 0}
